title: Acid–base optical and NMR response of an azo isoDPP dye
difficulty_reasons: Generate chemically valid species and decide which conditions and observables can discriminate them.
Choose a model that can connect both optical and NMR behavior to molecular change.
Determine whether the data resolve a unique assignment or support only a family of explanations.

data.description: Chemical identity, declared observations and physical boundaries.

required_deliverables.description: Structured research records, quantitative findings and artifact links.
